question: Colonel (retd) Narendra Kumar, an Indian soldier and ______, passed away in December 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mountaineer**__.

__
 
• **Ace mountaineer Colonel Narendra Kumar, who helped India secure the Siachen Glacier, passed away in December 2020**__.

 __
 
• He was responsible for the success of **Operation** **Meghdoot **in **1984**.
 
• He was the first Indian to climb the Nanda Devi mountain.
 
• He climbed Mount Everest, Mount Blanc (the highest peak in the Alps) in 1965, and later, Mount Kanchenchanga.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Bachendri Pal, **an Indian mountaineer, is the first Indian woman to climb Mount Everest, the highest mountain peak in the world.

 
 
• She achieved this feat in **1984 **and was later awarded the Padma Shri.
